description:
Prism 7 Resourcing are looking to recruit a temporary HR Support Administrator for a 2-month temporary contract, based in Maldon, Essex.

Please note that this role will require you to be based on site full time initially, reducing once fully trained.

Role Purpose:
- To provide professional, timely and accurate HR case management support to managers and employees, ensuring consistent application of HR policies, procedures and employment legislation.
- To ensure compliance with statutory requirements, council policies and good HR practice in the handling of HR cases and enquiries.
- To enable the effective delivery of HR services by resolving a wide range of employee relations and people-related cases, escalating more complex matters where appropriate.
- To support and develop effective HR processes, guidance and systems that enable selfservice and improve the customer experience.
- To ensure that HR enquiries and cases are managed efficiently, accurately and to agreed standards and timescales.
- To contribute positively to the HR service, acting professionally and collaboratively and demonstrating integrity, resilience and a strong customer-focused approach.

The Experience You Will Bring:
- Good understanding of Human Resources policies, procedures and practices within a case management environment.
- Working knowledge of employment legislation and regulations relevant to HR casework, with the ability to apply these in day-to-day activities.
- Understanding of confidentiality, data protection requirements and information governance in handling sensitive employee information.
- Knowledge of customer-focused service delivery and the principles of providing timely, accurate and professional advice.
- Understanding of case management processes, workflows and escalation routes within a specialist HR service.

title: Part Time Managing Partner , Finance & Strategy

Managing Partner - Finance & Strategy

Part-time role

You think like a business owner, not simply a finance professional.

You are proactive, commercially astute and accountable. Rather than identifying problems, you develop solutions, engage stakeholders and deliver results.

Finance Function Ownership & Transformation

Take full ownership of the finance function, supporting the company's growth ambitions.

Review financial systems, processes, reporting, controls and team capabilities.

Identify gaps, establish priorities and implement improvements.

Build scalable financial infrastructure and strengthen accountability.

Lead financial transformation from assessment through to delivery.

Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning and working capital.

Develop budgets, financial models, forecasts and scenario plans.

Anticipate funding requirements, investment needs and financial pressures.

Introduce forecasting processes to support informed decisions.

Ensure growth plans have realistic financial and resource planning.

Own P&L performance, including revenue, costs, margins and profitability.

Analyse results, identify trends and challenge underperformance.

Work with commercial and operational teams to improve margins and efficiency.

Establish meaningful KPIs and management reporting.

Review pricing, contracts, investment decisions and commercial opportunities.

Translate financial information into recommendations that improve performance.

Business Strategy & Growth

Partner with the CEO to develop and deliver financial and commercial strategy.

Understand the business model, revenue streams, customers and operating costs.

Identify changes required to support sustainable growth.

Assess whether structures, resources and processes can support expansion.

Develop business cases and financial plans for strategic initiatives.

Challenge existing approaches and turn opportunities into action.

Technology, Systems & Scalability

Review finance systems to improve reporting, automation and efficiency.

Implement scalable processes delivering accurate financial information.

Strengthen forecasting and reporting as the business grows.

Collaborate with internal teams and external partners on improvements.

Apply knowledge of SaaS, technology or digital business models where relevant.

Leadership & Business Partnership

Act as a strategic partner to the CEO and senior leadership team.

Lead financial decisions, establish priorities and own outcomes.

Build and develop the finance team and wider financial capabilities.

Promote commercial awareness, accountability and informed decisions.

Build relationships while confidently challenging senior stakeholders.

Significant experience in senior finance, commercial finance or financial leadership.

Ideally, experience within SaaS, technology or a high-growth business.

Strong P&L management, cash flow forecasting, budgeting and financial modelling skills.

Proven experience building, restructuring or transforming a finance function.

Excellent understanding of revenue, costs, margins and profitability.

Experience implementing financial systems, processes and reporting.

Sound commercial judgement and ability to identify improvements.

Confidence influencing senior stakeholders and challenging established thinking.

Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on financial analysis.

A proven record of driving change and delivering measurable results.

ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualifications would be advantageous, although commercial capability, strategic thinking and the ability to deliver change are equally important.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to shape the finance function and influence the future of a growing business.

You will have the autonomy to assess what is needed, influence decisions and implement the financial foundations, systems and capabilities required for sustainable growth.
